findings.title: StatefulSet's governing Service is missing or not headless
findings.cause: StatefulSet db's governing Service db-headless does not exist, so its pods have no DNS names (db-0.db-headless.kd-statefulset-missing-service.svc does not resolve)

evidence.what: StatefulSet db names Service db-headless as its governing Service
evidence.command: kubectl get statefulset db -n kd-statefulset-missing-service -o jsonpath='{.spec.serviceName}'

evidence.what: there is no Service db-headless in namespace kd-statefulset-missing-service

findings.fix: Create a headless Service db-headless (clusterIP: None) that selects the StatefulSet's pods, or set serviceName to the one that exists.
